subject: [PATCH v4 14/14] selftests/nfsd: check that listener removal asks rpcbind once

2026-08-31.patch_summary: This patch adds a test case to the NFS daemon selftest suite to verify that removing a listener from the RPC bind service only results in one call to rpcbind, even if multiple listeners are removed at once. The test creates a stub RPC bind service and registers three listeners with it, then removes them one by one while monitoring the number of calls made to rpcbind. It checks that the second and third removals do not result in additional calls to rpcbind, ensuring that the listener removal process is efficient and does not incur unnecessary overhead.
